news.title: Company Sets Q2 Earnings Release Date
news.text: Viking Therapeutics announced it would report second-quarter 2025 financial results after market close on July 23.

news.title: Q2 2025 Results Highlight R&D Spend
news.text: Viking reported a Q2 net loss of $65.6 million, or $0.58 per share, as obesity program investments lifted R&D expenses beyond expectations.

news.title: Analysts Update Price Targets
news.text: Citigroup kept a Neutral stance while raising its price target and Raymond James reaffirmed Strong Buy but trimmed its target following Viking's earnings.

news.title: Positive VK2735 Phase 2 Oral Data
news.text: Viking reported encouraging top-line results from the Phase 2 VENTURE oral dosing trial of VK2735 in obesity, supporting further development.

news.title: HC Wainwright Reiterates Buy Rating
news.text: HC Wainwright reaffirmed its Buy rating on Viking Therapeutics, emphasizing the long-term opportunity in metabolic disease programs.

news.title: BTIG Maintains Buy Outlook
news.text: BTIG Research reiterated a Buy rating on Viking, citing continued momentum in the VK2735 obesity franchise.

news.title: Corporate Presentation Highlights Pipeline
news.text: Viking released an investor presentation detailing Phase 3 plans for subcutaneous VK2735 and Phase 2a progress for the oral formulation.

news.title: Maintenance Dosing Study Initiated
news.text: Viking launched a maintenance dosing trial for VK2735 exploring multiple subcutaneous and oral regimens ahead of ObesityWeek data.

news.title: ObesityWeek Presentations Slated for November
news.text: The company announced plans to present VK2735 obesity program data at ObesityWeek 2025, signaling upcoming clinical visibility.
